purpose: Versioned, provenance-preserving classical source operators for outcome-blind source evaluation. No record authorizes a market bridge, currency direction, magnitude, polarity, score, or execution.

operators.author: Pt. Mithalal Vyas
operators.translationOrLiteralSense: Planet class is text-specific and can be conditional for Moon and Mercury; retrograde intensifies categorically, while swift retains natural character.
operators.directSourceClaim: Base krura/saumya classes, Moon and Mercury conditions, and categorical retrograde/swift effects are source-recorded.
conditions: Moon requires a source-defined lunar condition
Mercury requires same-pada or same-navamsa krura association when the conditional override is evaluated
exceptions: Shukla Panchami overlap remains unknown
No numeric value follows from MAHAKRURA or MAHASHUBHA

exceptions: Rahu and Ketu do not inherit a seven-planet matrix cell
